body:
Added page-source (GET /session/{id}/source) to the WebDriver client, needed to scrape a JS-rendered page (BusinessWire's newsroom, confirmed by the founder in-browser: raw HTML has no list data). Found and fixed a real bug in tests/fake_webdriver_server.go: Go's default json.Encoder HTML-escapes '<'/'>'/'&', which no real driver does for a page-source response -- fixed with SetEscapeHTML(false). New test_webdriver.c assertion, make test-webdriver: 0 failures. Not yet done, honestly flagged: no Go-pipeline integration, no chromium/chromedriver in this sandbox to verify live, BusinessWire's real markup still unseen. Commit dc60e44.

⚓ ☃
title: webdriver.prn: page-source + a real fixture JSON-escaping bug fix
